effect.ZERO_FLUX_ALWAYS_ON: The zero-flux speed boost works at any flux level.
effect.ZERO_FLUX_BOOST_FLUX_LEVEL_PERCEN: The zero-flux speed boost also works while flux is at or below <good>{value}%</good>.
effect.SHIP_RECOVERY_CHANCE_BONUS: If disabled, this ship is almost always recoverable after the battle.
stat.armorDamageTakenPerDMod: armor damage taken per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods
effect.PD_IGNORES_DECOY_FLARES: Point-defense weapons can identify and ignore decoy flares.
effect.PD_BEST_TARGET_LEADING: Point-defense weapons get the best possible target leading, regardless of combat readiness.
effect.PD_RECLASSIFY_SMALL_WEAPONS: All small non-missile, non-strike weapons are classified as point-defense, automatically target missiles and are affected by point-defense stat modifiers.
effect.BALLISTIC_COUNTS_AS_ENERGY: Ballistic weapons also gain this ship's energy weapon modifiers.
effect.BALLISTIC_SLOTS_HYBRID: Ballistic weapon mounts become hybrid mounts.
effect.ENERGY_SLOTS_BALLISTIC: Energy weapon mounts become ballistic mounts.
effect.BALLISTIC_SLOTS_ENERGY: Ballistic weapon mounts become energy mounts.
effect.MISSILE_SLOTS_ENERGY: Missile weapon mounts become energy mounts.
effect.SMALL_SLOTS_UNIVERSAL: Small weapon mounts become universal mounts.
stat.commandPointRecoveryWhileFlagship: command point recovery rate while this ship is the flagship
stat.fluxRateOfFireAndAmmoRegenWhilePhas: flux dissipation, weapon rate of fire and ammo regeneration while phased
effect.PHASE_ANCHOR_EMERGENCY_DIVE: While at risk of being destroyed or disabled, this ship can instead perform an emergency dive into phase space, retreating from battle and suffering an additional combat readiness penalty equal to {value}% of its deployment cost. The ship must have enough combat readiness to cover this cost. Only one ship per battle, regardless of side, can perform this dive.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_SPLIT_TARGETS_FLAT.on: Beam weapon hits split their damage evenly across the target and up to {value} additional nearby enemy ship. Strikecraft are never chosen. The target acquisition range is half the beam weapon's range.
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_SPLIT_TARGETS_FLAT.ot: Beam weapon hits split their damage evenly across the target and up to {value} additional nearby enemy ships. Strikecraft are never chosen. The target acquisition range is half the beam weapon's range.
effect.EXPLODE_ON_DEATH: When this ship is destroyed, it detonates violently, dealing high-explosive damage equal to up to {value}% of its maximum fuel capacity to nearby ships, tapering off with distance.
effect.NON_BEAM_ENERGY_WEAPON_CHAIN_CHAN: Non-beam energy weapon hits that land on an enemy shield have a <good>{value}%</good> chance to refract: the same weapon fires a copy of the shot from that shield at the nearest other enemy ship within the weapon's range. A refracted shot that hits an enemy shield has the same chance to refract again.
effect.NON_BEAM_ENERGY_WEAPON_CHAIN_FALL: Each refraction deals <bad>{value}%</bad> less damage than the shot before it.
effect.BALLISTIC_HARDPOINT_KINETIC_TO_HI: Kinetic damage from weapons in ballistic hardpoints is converted to high explosive damage.
effect.BEAM_ENERGY_TO_HIGH_EXPLOSIVE: Energy damage from beam weapons is converted to high explosive damage.
effect.SMALL_ENERGY_MOUNT_DAMAGE_TO_EMP: All damage from weapons in small energy mounts is converted to EMP damage.
effect.BALLISTIC_WEAPON_PIERCE_CHANCE_PE: Ballistic projectile hits on an enemy ship's armor or hull have a <good>{value}%</good> chance to pierce. A pierced shot cannot pierce again.
effect.NON_MISSILE_PROJECTILE_ECHO_CHANC: Non-missile projectiles that hit an enemy ship have a <good>{value}%</good> chance to be fired again from the same weapon.
effect.ESCORT_MANEUVER_BONUS_PERCENT: While within {range} su of a larger friendly ship, up to {value}% increased maneuverability, fading out over a further {fade} su. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_SPEED_BONUS_PERCENT: While within {range} su of a larger friendly ship, up to {value}% increased top speed, fading out over a further {fade} su. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.ESCORT_WEAPON_RANGE_BONUS_PERCENT: While within {range} su of a larger friendly ship, up to {value}% increased ballistic and energy weapon range, fading out over a further {fade} su. Doubled for a destroyer escorting a capital ship.
effect.NANOFORGE_HULL_REGEN_PERCENT: After {seconds} seconds without taking hull damage, repairs {value}% of maximum hull per second in combat, up to {limit}% of maximum hull in total per deployment.
effect.DISINTEGRATION_ARMOR_DAMAGE_PERCE: Energy weapon hits on armor strip an additional {value}% of the hit's damage from the armor around the impact.
effect.TERRIFYING_PRESENCE_ACCURACY_PENA: Enemy ships within {range} su have <good>-{value}%</good> to the target leading accuracy of their autofiring weapons. Penalties from several ships with this effect stack.
effect.NON_BEAM_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PER_SPEED_: <good>{value}%</good> increased ballistic and non-beam energy weapon damage for every su/s of the ship's current speed.
effect.MEDIUM_ENERGY_SLOT_WEAPON_RANGE_F: <good>+{value}</good> to the base range of weapons in medium energy slots.
effect.SHIELD_ABSORB_RATE_OF_FIRE_PERCEN: Flux taken by the shield charges a reserve of up to {max}, which drains by {drain} per second. While charged, up to <good>{value}%</good> increased ballistic and energy weapon rate of fire, at full strength from {full} reserve. Non-beam weapons also cost less flux per shot, so their faster fire costs no extra flux.
effect.HEARTLESS_ON_NEARBY_DESTRUCTION_R: Whenever a non-strikecraft ship is destroyed within {value} su, this ship gains a Heartless stack until the end of combat. Ships can hold up to {stacks} Heartless stacks.
effect.HEARTLESS_ARMOR_RESTORE_PERCENT: Gaining a Heartless stack restores <good>{value}%</good> of maximum armor to every armor cell.
effect.HEARTLESS_ARMOR_PERCENT_PER_STACK: Each Heartless stack grants <good>{value}%</good> more armor in every armor cell, above its normal maximum.
effect.HEARTLESS_MOBILITY_PENALTY_PERCEN: <bad>{value}%</bad> reduced top speed and maneuverability for each Heartless stack.
effect.HEARTLESS_RADIATION_EMP_FLAT: Each new Heartless stack sets off a radiation surge that deals <bad>{value}</bad> EMP damage to a random weapon and to a random engine on this ship.
effect.HEARTLESS_CREW_DEATH_CHANCE_PERCE: Each Heartless stack has a <bad>{value}%</bad> chance to sacrifice a crew member for each missile fired.
effect.HEARTLESS_MISSILE_DAMAGE_PERCENT_: <good>{value}%</good> increased missile damage for each Heartless stack while the fleet has crew left to give.
effect.HEARTLESS_MISSILE_SPEED_PERCENT_P: <good>{value}%</good> increased missile top speed for each Heartless stack while the fleet has crew left to give.
effect.SERAPHS_GRACE_MAX_STACKS_FLAT: Every {damage} armor and hull damage this ship takes grants a stack of Borrowed Grace lasting {duration} seconds, up to <good>{value}</good> stacks. Stack timers pause while the ship is phased.
effect.SERAPHS_GRACE_PERCENT_PER_STACK: Each Borrowed Grace stack grants <good>{value}%</good> increased top speed, flux dissipation and weapon rate of fire, and <good>{value}%</good> reduced weapon flux cost and damage taken.
effect.SERAPHIM_HEAL_PERCENT: Repairs hull equal to <good>{value}%</good> of the armor and hull damage this ship deals to enemy ships.
effect.SERAPHIM_HEAL_CAP_PERCENT: Seraph Hunting Routines repair at most <good>{value}%</good> of this ship's maximum hull per battle.
effect.SERAPHIM_DAMAGE_BONUS_PERCENT: Up to <good>{value}%</good> increased ballistic and energy weapon damage, building up as this ship deals armor and hull damage to enemy ships. At the full bonus, the zero-flux speed boost works at any flux level.
effect.SERAPHIM_FULL_BONUS_DAMAGE_FLAT: The full Seraph Hunting Routines damage bonus is reached after dealing {value} armor and hull damage.
effect.BALLISTIC_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PERCENT_P: <good>{value}%</good> increased ballistic weapon damage for every {step} Low Tech Affinity.
<bad>{value}%</bad> reduced ballistic weapon damage for every {step} Low Tech Affinity.
effect.ENERGY_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PERCENT_PER_: <good>{value}%</good> increased energy weapon damage for every {step} High Tech Affinity.
<bad>{value}%</bad> reduced energy weapon damage for every {step} High Tech Affinity.
effect.MISSILE_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PERCENT_PER: <good>{value}%</good> increased missile weapon damage for every {step} Midline Affinity.
<bad>{value}%</bad> reduced missile weapon damage for every {step} Midline Affinity.
effect.ARMOR_PERCENT_PER_LOW_TECH_AFFINI: <good>{value}%</good> increased armor for every {step} Low Tech Affinity.
<bad>{value}%</bad> reduced armor for every {step} Low Tech Affinity.
effect.WEAPON_RANGE_PERCENT_PER_AFFINITY: <good>{value}%</good> increased weapon range for every {step} affinity.
<bad>{value}%</bad> reduced weapon range for every {step} affinity.
effect.FIGHTER_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PERCENT_PER: Strikecraft launched from this ship have <good>{value}%</good> increased weapon damage for every {step} affinity.
Strikecraft launched from this ship have <bad>{value}%</bad> reduced weapon damage for every {step} affinity.
effect.FIGHTER_DAMAGE_TAKEN_MULT_PER_AFF: Strikecraft launched from this ship take <bad>{value}%</bad> more damage for every {step} affinity.
Strikecraft launched from this ship take <good>{value}%</good> less damage for every {step} affinity.
effect.HIGHEST_AFFINITY_FLAT_PER_S_MOD.m: <good>+{value}</good> to your highest affinity for each s-mod on this ship.
effect.HIGHEST_AFFINITY_FLAT_PER_S_MOD.l: <bad>-{value}</bad> to your highest affinity for each s-mod on this ship.
effect.LOWEST_AFFINITY_AS_HIGHEST: Your lowest affinity counts as equal to your highest.
effect.AFFINITY_EXCHANGE_TO_LOW_TECH_PER: Removes all High Tech and Midline Affinity and grants <good>{value}%</good> of it as Low Tech Affinity.
effect.AFFINITY_EXCHANGE_TO_HIGH_TECH_PE: Removes all Low Tech and Midline Affinity and grants <good>{value}%</good> of it as High Tech Affinity.
effect.AFFINITY_EXCHANGE_TO_MIDLINE_PERC: Removes all Low Tech and High Tech Affinity and grants <good>{value}%</good> of it as Midline Affinity.
effect.STRIKECRAFT_GAIN_AFFINITY_BONUSES: Strikecraft launched from this ship gain its affinity bonuses to hull, armor and flux.
effect.EVERY_AFFINITY_FLAT_PER_HOLLOW_NO: Takes over every node in its radius for free. Each grants <good>+{value}</good> to every affinity instead of its own effects.
Takes over every node in its radius for free. Each grants <bad>-{value}</bad> to every affinity instead of its own effects.
effect.GATES_RADIUS_BELOW_HALF_HULL: Allocated nodes in its radius apply only below 50% hull, at <good>{value}</good> times their strength. Their effects that aren't read live in combat are ignored.
effect.GATES_RADIUS_WHILE_SYSTEM_ACTIVE: Allocated nodes in its radius apply only while the ship system is active, at <good>{value}</good> times their strength. Their effects that aren't read live in combat are ignored.
effect.GATES_RADIUS_WHILE_PHASED: Allocated nodes in its radius apply only while phased, at <good>{value}</good> times their strength. Their effects that aren't read live in combat are ignored.
effect.TARGETED_HULL_ITEM_EFFECT_PERCENT: <good>{value}%</good> increased effect of the targeted hull item.
<bad>{value}%</bad> reduced effect of the targeted hull item.
effect.SOCKETED_HULL_ITEM_DRAWBACK_EFFEC: <bad>{value}%</bad> increased effect of hull item drawbacks.
<good>{value}%</good> reduced effect of hull item drawbacks.
effect.CREW_STEAL_RANGE_FLAT: Enemy ships destroyed within {value} su of this ship have their survivors pressed into service. Each wreck is only claimed once.
effect.DYNAMIC_GRID_ENERGY_WEAPON_BONUS_: Once shields have been down for {frigate}/{destroyer}/{cruiser}/{capital} seconds while not venting or overloaded, <good>{value}%</good> increased energy weapon rate of fire and <good>{value}%</good> reduced energy weapon flux cost.
effect.ION_ARC_CHANCE_PERCENT: Energy shots that hit an enemy shield can arc through to its hull, dealing {damage}% of the shot's damage plus {emp}% as EMP. The chance is <good>{value}%</good> when the target is at full hard flux and falls with its hard flux.
effect.GRAVITY_DRAG_TIMEFLOW_PERCENT: Enemy ships within {range} su have up to <good>{value}%</good> less timeflow, strongest at close range, or up to <good>{phased}%</good> less while this ship is phased. Gravitational drag from every source is capped at {cap}% per ship.
effect.TERMINAL_DESCENT_HULL_DAMAGE_TAKE: When its hull drops below {enter}% during a battle, the ship enters Terminal Descent until its hull is back above {leave}%. During Terminal Descent, <good>{value}%</good> reduced hull damage taken, but peak performance time stops and venting is blocked.
effect.DISPLACER_FAILSAFE_HULL_PERCENT: Once per deployment, when hull drops below <good>{value}%</good>, this ship teleports {distance} su away from the nearest enemy and vents its flux.
effect.NON_MISSILE_WEAPON_RANGE_CAP_FLAT: Non-missile weapon range can't exceed <bad>{value}</bad> su.
effect.TERMINAL_DESCENT_FLUX_DISSIPATION: <good>{value}%</good> increased flux dissipation during Terminal Descent.
effect.TERMINAL_DESCENT_SYSTEM_REGEN_PER: <good>{value}%</good> increased ship system charge regeneration during Terminal Descent.
effect.TERMINAL_DESCENT_SHIELD_DAMAGE_TA: <bad>{value}%</bad> increased shield damage taken during Terminal Descent.
effect.MODULE_HULL_PERCENT: This ship's modules have <good>{value}%</good> increased hull points.
effect.MODULE_ARMOR_PERCENT: This ship's modules have <good>{value}%</good> increased armor.
effect.RISE_FROM_THE_ASHES_HULL_PERCENT: Once per battle, the hit that would destroy this ship instead leaves it with <good>{value}%</good> of its maximum hull points.
effect.RISE_FROM_THE_ASHES_ARMOR_RESTORE: Surviving that hit restores <good>{value}%</good> of maximum armor to every armor cell.
effect.RISE_FROM_THE_ASHES_DAMAGE_TAKEN_: <good>{value}%</good> less damage taken for {seconds} seconds after surviving that hit.
<bad>{value}%</bad> more damage taken for {seconds} seconds after surviving that hit.
effect.THERMO_ACCELERATOR_FLUX_COST_REDU: Turret weapons have <good>{value}%</good> reduced flux cost. Hardpoint weapons can't fire.
effect.SOLARIS_OVERDRIVE_SECONDS_FLAT: Weapons cost no flux to fire for <good>{value}</good> seconds after this ship's system activates, at most once every {cooldown} seconds.
effect.SOLARIS_OVERDRIVE_PROJECTILE_SPEE: <good>{value}%</good> increased weapon projectile speed for those seconds.
effect.SOLARIS_OVERDRIVE_RATE_OF_FIRE_PE: <good>{value}%</good> increased weapon rate of fire for those seconds.
effect.FUROR_RATE_OF_FIRE_PERCENT: Damage dealt to enemy ships builds fury, granting up to <good>{value}%</good> increased weapon rate of fire, full after {frigate}/{destroyer}/{cruiser}/{capital} damage. Shield hits count at half, EMP at a quarter. Fury fades by {decay}% per second.
effect.MALFUNCTION_AURA_PERCENT: Enemy ships within {range} su have <good>{value}%</good> chance for their weapons to malfunction. Only the strongest applies.
effect.REPAIR_COORDINATOR_ARMOR_PERCENT: Repairs the armor of the closest damaged allied ship within {range} su by <good>{value}%</good> of its total armor per second. Each ship with this effect restores at most {perShip}% of any one ally's armor per battle, and each ally regains at most {limit}% in total from all of them. Pauses while overloaded or venting.
effect.WING_SCRAMBLE_COPIES: When this ship deploys, its wings that share a role lend each other strikecraft. Each wing keeps at least 1 of its own strikecraft and fills the rest of its normal wing size with up to <good>{value}</good> of every other strikecraft type in its group. All its wings use the engagement range of its longest-ranged wing. Strikecraft in each group fly at the group's average top speed.
effect.FIGHTER_WING_SHARED_DAMAGE_PERCEN: When a strikecraft launched from this ship takes a hit smaller than its max hull or flux, <good>{value}%</good> of that damage is shared across its wing.
effect.FIGHTER_WING_DAMAGE_TAKEN_PERCENT: Strikecraft launched from this ship take <good>{value}%</good> less damage for every living strikecraft of their wing out in space, up to {max}% less.
effect.CORROSION_MOTE_DAMAGE_FLAT: Every {seconds} seconds a beam weapon spends on an enemy ship's armor or hull, it launches a homing stardust mote at the target dealing <good>{value}</good> energy damage and <good>{value}</good> EMP. At most {max} of this ship's motes fly at once.
effect.CREW_STEAL_SKELETON_CREW_PERCENT: Takes <good>{value}%</good> of each such wreck's skeleton crew. They can feed Live Munitions straight away; after combat, the rest join your fleet if there is room.
effect.FLUX_SCALED_TOP_SPEED_FLAT: Top speed changes with flux, from <good>+{value}</good> su/s at no flux to <bad>-{value}</bad> su/s at full flux, with no change at half flux. Below half flux, also up to <good>{value}%</good> increased acceleration and turn acceleration.
effect.FLUX_SCALED_RATE_OF_FIRE_PERCENT: Weapon rate of fire changes with flux, from <good>{value}%</good> increased at no flux to <bad>{value}%</bad> reduced at full flux, with no change at half flux. Venting or being overloaded counts as full flux.
effect.FLUX_CAPACITOR_EFFECTIVENESS_PERC: <good>{value}%</good> increased flux capacity granted by each flux capacitor.
effect.AUGMENTED_FLUX_SCALED_PENALTY_RED: On hulls with Augmented Systems, <good>{value}%</good> reduced effect of the high-flux top speed and rate of fire penalties.
effect.AUGMENTED_INERTIAL_PROJECTILE_SPE: On hulls with Augmented Systems, also grants increased projectile speed equal to <good>{value}%</good> of the speed-based damage bonus.
effect.AUGMENTED_SYSTEM_REGEN_PERCENT: On hulls with Augmented Systems, <good>{value}%</good> increased ship system charge regeneration.
effect.FIGHTER_BAYS_FLAT.warning: Unallocating it returns any strikecraft wing in the bay it adds to your cargo.
effect.CONVERTED_HANGAR_FIGHTER_BAYS_FLA: <good>+{value}</good> to number of strikecraft bays, plus any extra bays from Vast Hangar.
effect.FIGHTER_REPLACEMENT_RATE_MULT.slo: <bad>{value}%</bad> slower strikecraft replacement rate decay and recovery.
effect.FIGHTER_REPLACEMENT_RATE_MULT.fas: <good>{value}%</good> faster strikecraft replacement rate decay and recovery.
effect.FIGHTER_FOCUS_FIRE_DAMAGE_PERCENT: Each hit by a strikecraft launched from this ship marks the enemy ship it hits, which then takes <good>{value}%</good> increased damage from this ship's strikecraft for each mark. The marks clear {reset} seconds after the last hit. Each second of beam contact counts as one hit.
effect.FIGHTER_FOCUS_FIRE_MAX_DAMAGE_PER: Strikecraft marks grant up to a maximum of <good>{value}%</good> increased damage taken.
effect.BOMBER_PAYLOAD_DETONATION_CHANCE_: Every {interval} seconds, each bomber launched from this ship that still carries any payload has a <bad>{value}%</bad> chance to set off one full salvo from every loaded weapon at once, destroying itself and damaging every ship nearby, friend or foe. Bombers within {distance} su of this ship's hull never detonate.
stat.damageToCapitalShips: damage to capital ships and stations
effect.BEAM_WEAPON_HARD_FLUX_PERCENT: <good>{value}%</good> of beam weapon damage dealt to shields is dealt as hard flux.
effect.SHIELD_DAMAGE_SHARED_PERCENT: Disperses {value}% of shield damage taken to allied ships within {range} su that aren't overloaded or venting, split evenly between them as hard flux.
effect.SHIELD_SOFT_FLUX_CONVERSION_PERCE: <good>{value}%</good> of shield damage taken is converted to soft flux.
effect.SHIELD_DAMAGE_PASSED_TO_ALLY_PERC: <good>{value}%</good> of shield damage taken is passed to the nearest allied ship within {range} su as soft flux.
effect.PHASE_FIELD_CONTRIBUTION_PERCENT: {value}% of this ship's sensor strength counts toward the fleet-wide reduction in detected-at range that phase ships provide. Only applies while your fleet's transponder is off.
effect.SENSOR_STRENGTH_ALWAYS_COUNTS: This ship's sensor strength always contributes to fleet-wide sensor strength.

stat.topSpeedPerDMod: top speed per D-mod, up to 5 D-mods

effect.GROUND_SUPPORT_PER_MAX_CREW_PERCE: Your fleet gains effective planetary raid strength equal to <good>{value}%</good> of this ship's maximum crew capacity, up to the total number of marines in the fleet.
effect.BALLISTIC_WEAPON_DAMAGE_PER_BURN_: <good>{value}%</good> more ballistic weapon damage for every burn level this ship has above its hull's default.
effect.MISSILE_RELOAD_PERCENT_PER_MINUTE: Missile weapons that cannot regenerate ammo reload <good>{value}%</good> of their base ammo every minute in combat.
effect.ENERGY_WEAPON_RANGE_PER_SENSOR_ST: <good>+{value}</good> to energy weapon range for every point of this ship's sensor strength.
effect.ARMOR_FLAT_FOR_LOW_BASE_ARMOR: Up to <good>+{most}</good> to armor. The bonus is highest on hulls with the least base armor and falls to <good>+{least}</good> at <hl>{cutoff}</hl> base armor. Can't be allocated on phase ships or on hulls with more base armor than that.
effect.ARMOR_FLAT_FOR_LOW_BASE_ARMOR.hul: Up to <good>+{most}</good> to armor. The bonus is highest on hulls with the least base armor and falls to <good>+{least}</good> at <hl>{cutoff}</hl> base armor. Can't be allocated on phase ships or on hulls with more base armor than that.
effect.REPAIR_TIME_MULT.reduces: <good>{value}%</good> less weapon and engine repair time.
effect.REPAIR_TIME_MULT.increases: <bad>{value}%</bad> more weapon and engine repair time.
stat.minimumCrewRequiredPerFighterBay: minimum crew required per strikecraft bay
stat.minimumCrewRequiredPerFighterBayCap: minimum crew required per strikecraft bay, up to 80% in total
effect.REMOVE_CIVILIAN_HULL_PENALTY: Removes the penalties of a civilian-grade hull.
effect.CREATE_FRONT_SHIELD_IF_NONE: Installs a makeshift, front-facing shield if this ship has none.
effect.CONVERT_SHIELD_TO_FRONT: Converts this ship's shield to front-facing.
effect.CONVERT_SHIELD_TO_OMNI: Converts this ship's shield to omni-directional.
effect.SHIELD_ARC_FIXED: Shield arc is fixed at <hl>{value}</hl> degrees and can't be modified.
effect.DEATH_ON_COLLISION: Touching another ship's hull, however slightly, is instantly fatal to this ship. Strikecraft, wrecks and asteroids don't count.
effect.RAM_BIGGEST_ENEMY: When this ship isn't flown by you, it flies straight at the biggest enemy ship, intent on colliding.
